\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,mathtools}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\absv}{\lvert}{\rvert}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\pceil}{\lceil}{\rceil}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter\pfloor{\lfloor}{\rfloor}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\nrm}{\lVert}{\rVert}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\fcomp}{\lvert}{\rvert}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\inner}{\langle}{\rangle}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\gen}{\langle}{\rangle}
\DeclarePairedDelimiterX{\ip}[2]{\langle}{\rangle}{#1, #2}
\newcommand{\abs}[1]{\left|#1\right|}
\newcommand{\card}[1]{\lvert #1\rvert}
\newcommand{\norm}[1]{\left\| #1 \right\|}
\newcommand{\floor}[1]{\left\lfloor #1 \right\rfloor}
\newcommand{\ceil}[1]{\lceil #1 \rceil}
\newcommand{\E}{\mathbb{E}}
\newcommand{\Prob}{\Pr}
\newcommand{\PP}{\mathbb{P}}
\newcommand{\ket}[1]{| #1 \rangle}
\newcommand{\bra}[1]{\langle #1 |}
\newcommand{\braket}[2]{\langle #1 | #2 \rangle}
\begin{document}
Abs $\abs{x}$, $\abs{\frac{a}{b}} + \abs{y}$, $\absv{x}$, $\lvert y \rvert$, $\left| z \right|$, card $\card{S}$, norm $\norm{v}$,
$\lVert w \rVert$, $\|u\|$, floor $\floor{x/2}$, $\lfloor t \rfloor$, ceil $\ceil{n/2}$, $\lceil s\rceil + 1$.
Binom $\binom{n}{k}$ and $\tbinom{n}{2}$ and $\dbinom{m}{j}$ and $x = \binom{a+b}{c} y$.
Derivative $\frac{d}{dx} f$, $\frac{dy}{dx}$, $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}$, $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2}$,
$\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x \partial y}$, $\frac{\mathrm{d}^2 y}{\mathrm{d} x^2}$.
Transpose $A^T$, $A^\top$, $\mathbf{M}^{\mathsf{T}}$, $B^{\mathrm{T}} C$; inverse $f^{-1}(y)$, $A^{-1}$, $\sin^{-1} x$.
Mod $a \equiv b \pmod{m}$, $a \bmod m$. Factorial $n!$, $(n+1)!$, $n!!$. Big-O $O(n^2)$, $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$.
Probability $\Pr[X = 1]$, $\E[X]$, $\Prob(A)$, $\PP(B)$. Set $\{x \mid x > 0\}$, $\{ y : y < 1\}$.
Interval $[a, b)$. Sum $\sum_{i=1}^n i$.
Dirac: ket $\ket{\psi}$, bra $\bra{\phi}$, braket $\braket{\phi}{\psi}$, bra-operator-ket $\bra{\phi} A \ket{\psi}$,
bare $|\psi\rangle$,
Paired: $\absv*{\frac{a}{b}}$, $\absv[\big]{y}$, $\absv[\Bigg]{x} + \absv{z}$, $\pceil*{\frac{n}{2}}$, $\pfloor[\big]{x}$,
$\pfloor{y}$, $\nrm{v}$, $\nrm*{\frac{u}{2}}$, $\nrm[\Big]{w}$, $\fcomp*{x}$, $\inner{u, v}$, $\inner*{\frac{x}{2}, y}$,
$\inner[\big]{a, b}$, $\inner{u}$, $\gen{a, b}$, $\ip{u}{v}$, $\ip*{x}{y}$, $\absv*{x} + |y|$, a ket beside a bare bar $\ket{\psi} + |x|$, a ket beside an absolute value from its macro $\ket{\psi} + \abs{x}$.
\end{document}
